006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.datatype.adapter.MetaschemaDataTypeProvider;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.ArithmeticFunctionException;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.CastFunctionException;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.InvalidValueForCastFunctionException;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.impl.IntegerItemImpl;
013import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.IAtomicOrUnionType;
014import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.type.InvalidTypeMetapathException;
015import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
016
017import java.math.BigInteger;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020
021/**
022 * An atomic Metapath item containing an integer data value.
023 */
024public interface IIntegerItem extends IDecimalItem {
025  /**
026   * The integer value "1".
027   */
028  @NonNull
029  IIntegerItem ONE = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ONE));
030  /**
031   * The integer value "0".
032   */
033  @NonNull
034  IIntegerItem ZERO = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ZERO));
035  /**
036   * The integer value "-1".
037   */
038  @NonNull
039  IIntegerItem NEGATIVE_ONE = valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(BigInteger.ONE.negate()));
040
041  /**
042   * Get the type information for this item.
043   *
044   * @return the type information
045   */
046  @NonNull
047  static IAtomicOrUnionType<IIntegerItem> type() {
048    return MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.INTEGER.getItemType();
049  }
050
051  @Override
052  default IAtomicOrUnionType<? extends IIntegerItem> getType() {
053    return type();
054  }
055
056  /**
057   * Create an item from an existing integer value.
058   *
059   * @param value
060   *          a string representing an integer value
061   * @return the item
062   * @throws InvalidTypeMetapathException
063   *           if the provided value is not an integer
064   */
065  @NonNull
066  static IIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull String value) {
067    try {
068      return valueOf(MetaschemaDataTypeProvider.INTEGER.parse(value));
069    } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
070      throw new InvalidTypeMetapathException(null, ex.getMessage(), ex);
071    }
072  }
073
074  /**
075   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
076   *
077   * @param value
078   *          a long value
079   * @return the new item
080   */
081  @NonNull
082  static IIntegerItem valueOf(int value) {
083    @SuppressWarnings("null")
084    @NonNull
085    BigInteger bigInteger = BigInteger.valueOf(value);
086    return valueOf(bigInteger);
087  }
088
089  /**
090   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
091   *
092   * @param value
093   *          a long value
094   * @return the new item
095   */
096  @NonNull
097  static IIntegerItem valueOf(long value) {
098    @SuppressWarnings("null")
099    @NonNull
100    BigInteger bigInteger = BigInteger.valueOf(value);
101    return valueOf(bigInteger);
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
106   *
107   * @param value
108   *          a long value
109   * @return the new item
110   */
111  @NonNull
112  static IIntegerItem valueOf(boolean value) {
113    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(value ? BigInteger.ONE : BigInteger.ZERO));
114  }
115
116  /**
117   * Construct a new integer item using the provided {@code value}.
118   *
119   * @param value
120   *          an integer value
121   * @return the new item
122   */
123  @NonNull
124  static IIntegerItem valueOf(@NonNull BigInteger value) {
125    int signum = value.signum();
126
127    IIntegerItem retval;
128    if (signum == -1) { // negative
129      retval = new IntegerItemImpl(value);
130    } else if (signum == 0) { // zero
131      retval = INonNegativeIntegerItem.valueOf(value);
132    } else { // positive
133      retval = IPositiveIntegerItem.valueOf(value);
134    }
135    return retval;
136  }
137
138  /**
139   * Cast the provided type to this item type.
140   *
141   * @param item
142   *          the item to cast
143   * @return the original item if it is already this type, otherwise a new item
144   *         cast to this type
145   * @throws InvalidValueForCastFunctionException
146   *           if the provided {@code item} cannot be cast to this type
147   */
148  @NonNull
149  static IIntegerItem cast(@NonNull IAnyAtomicItem item) {
150    IIntegerItem retval;
151    if (item instanceof IIntegerItem) {
152      retval = (IIntegerItem) item;
153    } else if (item instanceof INumericItem) {
154      retval = valueOf(((INumericItem) item).asInteger());
155    } else if (item instanceof IBooleanItem) {
156      retval = valueOf(((IBooleanItem) item).toBoolean());
157    } else {
158      try {
159        retval = valueOf(item.asString());
160      } catch (IllegalStateException | InvalidTypeMetapathException ex) {
161        // asString can throw IllegalStateException exception
162        throw new InvalidValueForCastFunctionException(ex);
163      }
164    }
165    return retval;
166  }
167
168  @Override
169  default IIntegerItem castAsType(IAnyAtomicItem item) {
170    return cast(item);
171  }
172
173  @Override
174  default IIntegerItem abs() {
175    BigInteger value = asInteger();
176    return value.signum() > -1 ? this : valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(value.abs()));
177  }
178
179  @Override
180  default IIntegerItem ceiling() {
181    return this;
182  }
183
184  @Override
185  default IIntegerItem floor() {
186    return this;
187  }
188
189  /**
190   * Convert this integer item to a Java int, precisely.
191   *
192   * @return the int value
193   * @throws CastFunctionException
194   *           if the value does not fit in an int
195   */
196  @Override
197  default int toIntValueExact() {
198    // asInteger() is well-defined for integer items, so this should be safe
199    try {
200      return asInteger().intValueExact();
201    } catch (ArithmeticException ex) {
202      throw new CastFunctionException(
203          CastFunctionException.INPUT_VALUE_TOO_LARGE,
204          this,
205          String.format("Integer value '%s' is out of range for a Java int.", asString()),
206          ex);
207    }
208  }
209
210  /**
211   * Create a new sum by adding this value to the provided addend value.
212   *
213   * @param addend
214   *          the second value to sum
215   * @return a new value resulting from adding this value to the provided addend
216   *         value
217   */
218  @NonNull
219  default IIntegerItem add(@NonNull IIntegerItem addend) {
220    BigInteger addendLeft = asInteger();
221    BigInteger addendRight = addend.asInteger();
222    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(addendLeft.add(addendRight)));
223  }
224
225  /**
226   * Determine the difference by subtracting the provided subtrahend value from
227   * this minuend value.
228   *
229   * @param subtrahend
230   *          the value to subtract
231   * @return a new value resulting from subtracting the subtrahend from the
232   *         minuend
233   */
234  @NonNull
235  default IIntegerItem subtract(@NonNull IIntegerItem subtrahend) {
236    BigInteger minuendInteger = asInteger();
237    BigInteger subtrahendInteger = subtrahend.asInteger();
238    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(minuendInteger.subtract(subtrahendInteger)));
239  }
240
241  /**
242   * Multiply this multiplicand value by the provided multiplier value.
243   *
244   * @param multiplier
245   *          the value to multiply by
246   * @return a new value resulting from multiplying the multiplicand by the
247   *         multiplier
248   */
249  @NonNull
250  default IIntegerItem multiply(@NonNull IIntegerItem multiplier) {
251    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().multiply(multiplier.asInteger())));
252  }
253
254  /**
255   * Divide this dividend value by the provided divisor value using integer
256   * division.
257   *
258   * @param divisor
259   *          the value to divide by
260   * @return a new value resulting from dividing the dividend by the divisor
261   */
262  @NonNull
263  default IIntegerItem integerDivide(@NonNull IIntegerItem divisor) {
264    BigInteger divisorInteger = divisor.asInteger();
265
266    if (BigInteger.ZERO.equals(divisorInteger)) {
267      throw new ArithmeticFunctionException(ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
268          ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO_MESSAGE);
269    }
270    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().divide(divisorInteger)));
271  }
272
273  /**
274   * Compute the remainder when dividing this dividend value by the provided
275   * divisor value.
276   *
277   * @param divisor
278   *          the value to divide by
279   * @return a new value containing the remainder resulting from dividing the
280   *         dividend by the divisor
281   */
282  @NonNull
283  default IIntegerItem mod(@NonNull IIntegerItem divisor) {
284    BigInteger divisorInteger = divisor.asInteger();
285
286    if (BigInteger.ZERO.equals(divisorInteger)) {
287      throw new ArithmeticFunctionException(ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
288          ArithmeticFunctionException.DIVISION_BY_ZERO_MESSAGE);
289    }
290
291    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().remainder(divisorInteger)));
292  }
293
294  @Override
295  default IIntegerItem negate() {
296    return valueOf(ObjectUtils.notNull(asInteger().negate()));
297  }
298
299  /**
300   * Compares this value with the argument.
301   *
302   * @param item
303   *          the item to compare with this value
304   * @return a negative integer, zero, or a positive integer if this value is less
305   *         than, equal to, or greater than the {@code item}.
306   */
307  default int compareTo(IIntegerItem item) {
308    return asInteger().compareTo(item.asInteger());
309  }
310}
